title: Cat Bond
shortDescription: Collect 33 cats, explore five illustrated regions, and build a team whose friendships grow along the way.
description: Your adventure begins with one curious kitten. Explore five illustrated regions, discover 33 collectible cats, and welcome new companions into your Sunlit Garden. Train your favorites, send them to work for rewards, and uncover friendship stories and shared memories as your cats grow closer. Choose a two-cat team for lively real-time encounters, time your skills and dodges, or turn on Auto Battle for a more relaxed adventure. Keep exploring—your next rare feline friend may be just around the corner.
instructions: Choose a starter kitten, then click or tap the glowing grass to encounter your first wild cat. Win the encounter to welcome a new friend. Open Cats to care for and train companions, choose your duo, and visit the map to explore new regions. In manual battles, move with WASD or arrow keys, aim with the mouse, left-click or press J to attack, use Q/E for skills, Space to dodge, R for an ultimate, and F for the Duo Special when charged. You can select Auto Battle before an encounter. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and on-screen buttons. Progress is saved locally in your browser.
savedProgress: The game saves locally in the browser. Saves are not synced to a CrazyGames account; clearing site storage can erase progress. Do not declare that the game needs no saves.
